title: Introduction to MBMM: fitting a Mechanistic Bayesian Mixture Model
text: Mechanistic Bayesian Mixture Model (MBMM) combines longitudinal mechanistic models covariate-linked latent-class model. subject, MBMM estimates posterior probabilities belonging latent biological states : productive infection versus non-establishment transient/abortive detection; boost-responsive versus weak/stable antibody kinetics. MBMM proceeds three stages: mechanistic trajectory model fitted eligible reference donors using Approximate Bayesian Computation (ABC). study subject scored one reference models, producing class-conditional log-likelihood latent state. class likelihoods linked subject-level covariates logistic multinomial gate model. gate fitted directly maximizing observed-data marginal likelihood. likelihood targeted EM implementation, direct optimization avoids explicitly iterating E- M-steps. package supports two common scoring structures: Bank versus bank: every latent class represented mechanistic trajectory bank. Productive infection versus analytic non-establishment: productive class represented mechanistic bank, non-establishment represented low-level analytic observation model. vignette demonstrates second structure using simulated correlate--protection data.

text: mbmm implements Mechanistic Bayesian Mixture Model (MBMM) framework , McCarthy, Rogers (2026), Mechanistic Bayesian Framework Latent-State Inference Vaccine Infection Immunology. MBMM infers posterior probabilities latent immunological states, productive infection versus non-establishment transient/abortive detection, boost-responsive versus weak/stable antibody phenotype, sparse longitudinal biomarker trajectories. framework embeds application-specific ordinary differential equation trajectory model inside Bayesian mixture likelihood evaluated Approximate Bayesian Computation (ABC) reference banks. Covariates linked latent-state probabilities logistic gate two classes multinomial gate two classes. package deliberately domain-agnostic. Users supply mechanistic trajectory model, ABC prior, observation model, covariate data. mbmm supplies shared inferential engine, including: ABC reference-bank construction; marginal reference-bank likelihoods; leave-one-donor-scoring; logistic multinomial gate fitting; likelihood-ratio permutation tests; fitted-threshold estimation uncertainty summaries; reduced manuscript-style simulation tools.
